tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i phur pa sgrub mchod kyi skabs su tshogs skad gtong tshul gyi brda sbyor blo gsal sgo 'byed bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra kī la ya/ phur sgrub chen mo'i tshogs skad gtong dgos kyi brda sbyor rnams phal cher sngar nged rang gis byas pa'i 'cham dpe nyung ngu gsum gyi gcig gi nang na mgo mjug tshang bar thus yod kyang / las dang po pa rnams la brda' ston dang ngag goms pa'i phyir/ sgrub mchod kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos pa'i tshogs skad nyung ngu re dgod par bya ste/ de yang 'cham sbyong snga ma'i chog bsgrigs kyi skabs/ 'o na gang ltar phur sgrub chen mo'i chog bsgrigs kyi skabs 'dir sa chog nas bsgrig dgos pas/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma bsgrig par mdzad pa'i phyag len 'dug pa bzhin bsgrig par zhu zhes brjod/ dbu mdzad bskul res su yin gyis bskul nas bsgrigs tshar ba dang / da sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed nang bzhin dbyangs rol dang bcas pa bdag bskyed du mdzad nas gtor bsngo bshags pa grub mtshams mdzad dgos/ sa sbyang ba dngos kyi/ rang gi mig g.yas par/ zhes pa nas/ bdag gis don yod dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes pa'i bar 'di bsgrig par mdzad pa'i phyag len bzhin bsgrig par zhu/ zhes brjod/ bsgrigs tshar ba dang / da sta gon nas bsgrig dgos/ bdag bskyed phur 'bring mdzad nas/ lha sta gon gyi mdun bskyed rkyang pa ma gtogs bsgrig pa mi mdzad 'dug pas/ oṃ badzra kro dha sogs nas/ dam tshig la dgongs 'khrid par gyur/ /rang gi snying kha nas ye shes pa'i sogs nas/ 'khor ba phur bu'i bar bsgrig par zhu/ zhes brjod/ bsgrigs tshar ba dang / da dngos gzhi la sgrub thabs rgyas pa bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i sgrub tshul dang mthun par mdzad nas/ chog bsgrigs kyi skabs 'dir bdag 'jug rkyang pa bsgrig par mdzad kyin 'dug pa bzhin/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ dad mos che bas dngos grub thob/ /ces pa'i bar 'di bsgrig par zhu/ zhes brjod/ bsgrigs tshar ba dang / da mjug nas bkra shis 'di bsgrig par mdzad pa'i phyag len 'dug pa ltar da lan kyang mdzad pa zhu/ zhes brjod/ bsgrigs tshar ba dang / 'o na gang ltar da lo'i phur sgrub chen mo 'di la dbyangs rol mo/ cho ga phyag len/ dus chen skabs na bza'i gzab spros mdzad dgos sogs gang spyi'i sar so so nas blo khur bskyed pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa zhig dang / sde bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur nges rang dgos rgyu yin pas so so nas nges pa dang / phur sgrub kyi 'cham sbyong sngon ma'i skabs 'dir/ rol 'gros nas brtsam/ mgo gug yan la pad skor re re/ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba dang / mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa gnyis/ steng 'og bar gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ rdo rje rkyang 'gros rnams la lnga pad/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rgya gram/ maṃ sa/ rakta/ rkang rus rnams la pad skor gnyis re/ rin chen lnga las grub pa dang / /dam can spyi'i bskul 'cham nas/ sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros kyi bar sogs la 'cham grul po kha yar mdzad pas pad skor sku ngal gso ba sogs kyi stabs gang 'os mdzad la/ gzhan thams cad la pad skor re re/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros tshar gnyis re/ rgya gram tshar gcig mdzad pa dang / e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nas/ rakta'i bar tshar gnyis re mdzad/ rakta dang / rkang rus mang tsam mdzad cing / 'cham sbyong rjes ma la pad skor lnga dgos pa rnams dang / sku ngal gso ba'i pad skor sogs ma gtogs thams cad la pad skor re re mdzad la/ rakta dang dang rkang rus mang tsam mdzad cing / gzhan 'cham sna tshang ma tshar re re mdzad/ sa 'dul dngos gzhi'i nyin/ mgo gug yan la pad skor gsum re dang / rdo rje phyed 'gros dang / rkyang 'gros tshar gsum re dang / rgya gram tshar gnyis mdzad cing /

gzhan rnams grangs mang nyung pad skor 'cham sbyong snga ma lugs mdzad/ de yang / chos dbyings bskyed pa/ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba sogs nas/ 'og byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bskyod 'gros/ rdo rje rgya gram/ rkang rus/ rin chen lnga las grub pa/ rdo rje'i khyug shog yum chen/ phyag brnyan/ phra man gyi 'og phyogs pa gnyis/ byang sgo ba rnams la bskyod 'gros gzhan rnams la 'cham tshul dang bstun pa'i ldem 'gros gcig brdeg dang / bzhi brdeg kho na yin la/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa nas/ dpal chen pa'i 'gying chen yan la 'jol stabs/ 'gying chen nas byang sgo'i bar la grol bsdu/ byugs pa'i rdzas gsum la phur skor dang phur rtse phyi la ston pa nges par mdzad/ me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum gyi zur gsum ka la rol mo che ba brdeg e las ma dang / yaṃ las rlung chen gnyis la dzam g.yas su gnon cing / waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon du gnan no/ /thod rlon la rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa bar dzam gsum byas la/ rol mo che ba drug la mdun nas skor/ rna ba g.yas su sleb pa dang dzam gsum byas la g.yon du ldog la grol bsdu bya/ sbrul rgyan la dzam gsum dang rol mo che ba lnga'i bar la 'cham dngos gzhi bya zhing / glang lpags la g.yas gsig bzhi dang / g.yon gsig bzhi/ spel ma bzhi rnams byas la grol bsdu bya ste/ kha do ra la blta ba kho na yin cing / zhing lpags la kha do ra'i phyir bltas la g.yas gsig bzhi/ yang kha nang ltas kyi g.yas gsig bzhi/ de nas spel ma bzhi rnams byas la grol bsdu bya/ stag lpags ni sked pa'i lta zur g.yas su dzam gsum byas la rol mo che ba bzhi la stag gi sham thabs dkri tshul gyis mdun nas bskor la g.yon du sleb pa dang grol bsdu bya/ baṃ brtag pa la g.yas nas g.yob pa la rol mo che ba gsum dang / brtag pa la chung ngu gsum/ g.yon pa la'ang des mtshungs/ g.yas g.yon re mos kyis g.yob pa la rol mo che bzhi dang /

brtag pa la chung gsum yin la/ gang ltar 'cham sbyong dang dngos gzhi'i skabs thams cad du pad skor dang / 'cham sna rnams tshar du mdzad sogs thugs brel dang bstun pa yang phyag len la 'dug pa bzhin thams cad kyis 'cham dpon la ma yengs par gzigs nas zang zing du ma song ba dang / da lta ka 'cham sbyong la sprug ste phebs pa zhu/ zhes brjod/ de nas stangs stabs bsgrig skabs/ 'o na gang ltar stangs stabs bsgrig pa'i skabs 'dir/ hūm̐ chen ka ra'i tshigs bcad gcig yongs rdzogs la dbyangs mdzad pa'i tshig rkang dang po la/ g.yas skor gyi 'cham tshul ngos tshig gnyis pa'i dbyangs kyi bar la pad skor gsum rdzogs pa dang / tshig bzhi pa la g.yas gsig sogs kyi 'cham tshul dang / sngags kyi bar la pad skor gsum rdzogs par mdzad rjes/ g.yas skor mdzad pa dang / stobs po che la dbyangs sogs gzhan hūm̐ chen ka ra dang 'dra ba la/ tshig dang po'i 'cham tshul dang sngags kyi mjug gi g.yas skor g.yon skor du 'gyur ba dang / tshig gnyis pa'i dbyangs kyi bar dang / sngags kyi ring la pad skor cha lugs go brje ba tsam yin pa 'cham sbyong gi skabs 'dir/ hūm̐ chen ka ra ma gtogs bsgrig par mi mdzad pa'i/ 'cham tshul thams cad gtso bo la gzigs nas 'grig par mdzad dgos so/ /zhes brjod nas/ rang ngam gzhan gyi oṃ 'dren nas brtsam ste 'cham dbyangs bsgrigs tshar ba dang / da de'i rjes su steng phyogs tshangs bsnol ma tshig ya mtha' ma mtha' bsdus pa'i dbyangs dang / kī la ya tshar gcig gi gdangs kyi bar la rdo rje 'bri ba'i 'cham tshul rnams lo re bzhin bsgrig par mdzad kyin 'dug pa bzhin da lam kyang bsgrig dgos 'dug pas/ thams cad kyis gtso bo la gzigs nas 'grig par mdzad dgos so/ /zhes brjod la/ rang ngam gzhan gyi dzā 'dren nas bzung bsgrigs tshar ba dang / des na de ring 'cham gyi skabs su 'grig po dga' rab yod mdog kha bas/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang thams cad kyis thugs rig bsgrims nas dal brel ran pa dang /

gral gyi bar thag snyoms pa sogs so so'i blo yul du nges pa dang / da lta ka zhwa thebs phod kha sogs gnang rgyu yin 'dug pas thams cad khyams smad du bzhugs pa zhu/ zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub mchod zhag mang nyung gang byed kyang / skyed skabs tsam du sleb pa'i dbang sogs byed na tshogs skad gtong dgos/ dgong chog gi bkra shis grub mtshams/ 'o na gang ltar nged cag kyang do nub nas dbang tshugs rgyu yin pas/ sang nas bzung rnga 'cham gyi mgur 'degs pa sogs dbyangs pa rnams kyi dbyangs sbyongs dang / 'cham pa rnams kyis rnga 'cham grub 'cham sogs rang skya 'pher nges so so nas sbyong lugs byed dgos yin pas/ de'i do dam 'cham slob pa'i slob dpon so sos mdzad pa zhu zhes brjod/ yang dbang mi byed na/ gong gi nged cag kyang dbang tshugs rgyu yin pas zhes pa'i tshig de dor bas chog pa sogs gang la yang skabs bab sbyor lugs shes dgos/ yang 'cham sbyong rjes ma'i nyi ma sngon ma'i dgongs/ rjes chog grub 'phral tshogs skad gtong dgos/ 'o na gang ltar 'cham sbyong rjes ma'i nyi ma'i skabs 'dir rnga 'cham nas dbyangs 'khor dang po gnyis re dang bstun 'cham skor gnyis re dang / rdo rje phyed 'gros rkyang 'gros/ sbal 'gros rnams kyang tshar gnyis re mdzad cing / grub 'cham la rkyang 'gros kyis don nas/ dgug gzhug tshar gcig gi rjes su rol mo 'then rkang dang dzam gyis brtsams nas/ pad skor dang / rkyang 'gros tshar gcig gi rjes su seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas/ dred mo'i bar tshar gnyis re mdzad pa'i/ seṅge dang dred mo'i thog mtha' gnyis la rkyang 'gros dang / gzhan rnams la nyis 'gros kho na mdzad rgyu yin zhing / 'cham sbyong gi skabs 'dir/ dred mo grub 'phral dgug gzhug mi mdzad par rol mo chems brdung pa dang / de nas g.yas log g.yon log ngos/ gdab kha'i 'cham tshar gcig gi rjes su/ dam tshig chen po'i sogs nas/

bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la bab/ /ces pa'i rjes su/ gdab tshul gyi 'cham lan gcig dang / byang chub mchog tu nas/ bdud dang bar du sogs kyi rjes su gdab tshul lan gcig mdzad rjes/ khro bo chen po nas/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod kyi bar brjod nas/ pad skor lcags 'then sogs kyi rjes su chems brdung dang / de nas g.yas log g.yon log ngos gdab kha'i 'cham gong bzhin dang / de nas bgegs byed pa yi sogs dang / pho nya bran dang sogs rdo rje gsang ba'i sogs dang / gdug cing sdang sems sogs dang / rdungs shig rdo rje sogs te/ gang ltar dam tshig chen po nas 'di'i bar gyi gdab tshul gnyis dang / gdab kha drug gi 'cham rnams dang bstun tshig rnams ya mtha' ma mtha' bsdus pa dbyangs dang bcas pa'i bar la/ 'cham tshul mdzad pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin dang / gdab kha rjes ma'i chems brdung gi rjes su g.yas log g.yon log sogs grub mtshams gdab kha'i 'cham mi mdzad pa/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs yongs rdzogs 'cham dang bcas pa mdzad cing / 'cham sbyong rjes ma la rnga 'cham gyi dbyangs 'khor rjes ma re dang / 'cham 'khor yang re re mdzad/ grub 'cham la dgug gzhug gong bzhin dang / seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas brtsam dred mo'i bar 'cham 'khor re re mdzad/ gdab tshul gnyis pa dang / gdab kha/ khro bo chen po/ rdo rje gsang ba/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /sogs tshig ya mtha' ma mtha' sbyar ba'i gdab kha gsum po mdzad/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i tshig ya mtha' ma mtha' gnyis mdzad cing / 'cham dngos gzhi'i nyin rnga 'cham la dbyangs 'khor gsum/ 'cham 'khor gsum re mdzad la/ rdo rje phyed 'gros gsum re/ rgya gram gnyis mdzad la/ grub 'cham la rkyang 'gros sogs 'chams/ dgug gzhug tshar gsum yang rkyang 'gros dang / seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas dred mo'i bar tshar gsum re/ de rjes dgug gzhug tshar gcig de nas gdab tshul gnyis/

gdab kha drug phyi nang gsang ba ma rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad pa phyag len yin pas rol mo ba dang / 'cham pa kun gyis blo yul du nges pa'i zar zir du ma song ba'i gang 'grig rang zhig mdzad dgos pas spang blang 'dzol med gnang ba dang / da lta ka 'cham sbyong la thams cad sprug ste phebs par zhu/ zhes brjod/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i snga dro bshad pa dang / gsol ba chos spyod kyi mjug gi bkra shis sogs grub rjes tshogs skad gtong dgos/ 'o na gang ltar da lo'i phur sgrub chen mo'i skabs kyi cho ga dbyangs rol 'cham sogs thams cad so so nas khur bskyed pa'i dga' rab rang byung bas rjes su yi rang zhing / de ring gtor 'bul gyi skabs su yar 'byon mar 'byon sogs kyi skabs phyag cha rnams la thugs rtog zhib pa dang bcas da lta thams cad gtor 'bul la srug ste phebs pa zhu/ zhes brjod/ de ltar gdan sa chen po'i phur pa sgrub mchod kyi tshogs skad gtong tshul gyi brda sbyor nyung ngu blo gsal sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin kho na snying dbus bsam pa'i sa skya pa chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gi don du rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i dmar cha'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin kho na la mgyogs par sbyar ba 'dis bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'di 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig de bzhin du 'gyur ba bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong rnams kyis mdzad du gsol// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal ldan sa skya'i phur pa sgrub mchod kyi skabs su tshogs skad gtong tshul gyi brda sbyor/ PAGE \*
